citation.title: Physics-informed deep learning model for line-integral diagnostics across fusion devices
citation.authors: Cong Wang, Weizhe Yang, Haiping Wang, Renjie Yang, Jing Li, Zhijun Wang, Yixiong Wei, Xianli Huang, Chenshu Hu, Zhaoyang Liu, Xinyao Yu, Changqing Zou, Zhifeng Zhao

topic: Physics-informed neural surrogate for 2D soft x-ray tomographic inversion on EAST and HL-2A
own_question: Can response-matrix information and a back-projection loss term improve neural reconstruction of 2D SXR emissivity from line-integral chords?
actual_method_and_evidence: Snapshot mapping from chord signals to F-B or NSGPT inversion profiles, evaluated with random 70/20/10 splits on synthetic and experimental datasets. Reported inference times are milliseconds on a GPU. The work has no temporal or causal nowcasting, does not use CES or ion temperature, and does not test real-time deployment.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Neural surrogates trained on conventional inversion outputs have been used to accelerate SXR profile reconstruction. Their accuracy is bounded by the quality of the labels.
claim_checks.original_pdf_locator: Sec.1 p.3; Sec.2.3 and Table 1 p.6-7
claim_checks.qualification: The targets are inversion outputs, not physical truth. The authors report back-projection mismatch of about 5% for the experimental labels.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Input is single-time SXR chord data and the target is a same-time inversion profile. Report arrival time was not studied.
validation_if_relevant: Random sample splits with no shot-wise or held-out-campaign separation stated. No uncertainty information was available.
forbidden_inferences: Do not cite as evidence for CES, ion temperature or temporal nowcasting.
Do not treat the reported ms timings as real-time deployment.
Do not present the inversion labels as ground truth.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Include at most as a single example citation that neural surrogates of diagnostic inversions are trained against conventional labels. Its line-integral setting differs from ours, so it should not be used beyond that point.
